name: lupriv_new
description: Lupriv new — evidencija radnog vremena (Express + Vue 3 + MySQL)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.db:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d mysql phpmyadmin
scripts.db:down: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml stop mysql phpmyadmin
scripts.setup: npm run db:up && sh -c 'for i in $(seq 1 30); do docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml exec -T mysql mysqladmin ping -h127.0.0.1 -uroot -prootpass --silent && break; sleep 2; done' && npm run migrate && npm run seed
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix server; npm run lint --prefix client
scripts.docker:seed: docker compose exec api npm run seed
